about_the_game:
IMPORTANT NOTE - YOU DO NOT NEED TO PURCHASE THIS DLC IF YOU ALREADY OWN THE RANGER CHARACTER FOR TALISMAN: DIGITAL CLASSIC EDITION. SIMPLY SIGN INTO YOUR NOMAD ACCOUNT ON BOTH GAMES AND IT WILL UNLOCK FOR YOU IN-GAME.

As a master of the hunt and an unparalleled tracker, the Ranger has spent years stalking elusive prey and neutralizing formidable foes that lurk in the wild. His keen senses and silent footsteps have forged him into an expert in navigating treacherous terrain, with his resolve as unyielding as the ancient forests he calls home.

Purchase this character pack to add the Ranger to your character collection in Talisman: Digital 5th Edition.

Character Stats

  • Strength - 4

  • Craft - 3

  • Fate - 4

  • Lives - 4

  • Alignment - Neutral

  • Starting Space - Forest

Special Abilities

  • You need not roll the die in the Chasm, Crags or Forest unless you wish to. If you choose to roll, you must accept the result.

  • You do not lose a life in the Desert.

  • Add 1 to your attack roll in battle with Dragons or Animals.

  • At any time during your turn, you may look at the top card of the Adventure deck.

  • Whenever you are instructed to draw Adventure cards, you may spend 1 fate to ignore this instruction.
